action.CONTINUE: Fully passing internally consistent complete packet; canonical bad candidate cannot receive this outcome
action.HOLD: Any missing, expired, inaccessible, contradictory, incomparable or unreproducible required evidence, or unavailable/incompatible recovery target
action.ROLLBACK: Complete supported candidate FAIL, baseline4/4 with no missingness/fallback, matching candidate replay, all artifacts accessible/unexpired/identified, exact compatible retained recovery target

contract.FAIL: Complete observed candidate violates any required value/missingness/full-parity condition
contract.PASS: All observed candidate rows pass all conditions
contract.UNKNOWN: Observed candidate cohort incomplete or incomparable

decision_clock: At or after all request evidence; canonical625
minimum_evidence: All four declared requests, unique and complete, in observations and both replay cohorts. Four requests are not four independent source examples.

recovery.FAIL: Fresh replay fails checks or is not a fresh recovery-check evidence kind
recovery.HOLD: Revalidated decision or target prerequisites do not support replay
recovery.RECOVERED: Fresh local recovery-check replay on identical requests: four85, missing/fallback0/4, full parity/lineage4/4

scope: Teaching choices for one deterministic fixed-feature-cell experiment; not statistically calibrated production SLOs.
